package service

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for service_method_accepts_dto_and_persistence_model_together: Signatures that mix transport DTOs and GORM models in the same service API.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type CreateUserRequest struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

type User struct {
	ID        uint           `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name      string         `gorm:"column:name"`
	Email     string         `gorm:"column:email"`
	CreatedAt time.Time      `gorm:"column:created_at"`
	DeletedAt gorm.DeletedAt `gorm:"index"`
}

type UserService struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (s *UserService) ProcessUser(ctx context.Context, req CreateUserRequest, user User) (*User, error) {
	user.Name = req.Name
	user.Email = req.Email
	user.CreatedAt = time.Now()
	result := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Create(&user)
	return &user, result.Error
}
